_meta.description: Human-reference AGT ground truth for the regression fixtures. Consumed by apps/vis-service/src/tools/agt-extractor-check.ts to measure extractor accuracy (V7 spec Rev1 §11 targets: hard-fact precision >=90%, false-hard-fact rate <=5%).
_meta.labeler: Claude (direct visual inspection of fixtures); review by Chuck recommended before treating as final ground truth
_meta.conventions: window_count counts distinct window OPENINGS (a multi-pane unit in one opening = 1); door_count counts visible door leaves/doorways (cabinetry panels, appliance fronts, and stair openings are NOT doors); 'acceptable' lists defensible alternative counts for genuinely ambiguous scenes — an extraction matching any acceptable value is correct; camera_perspective is advisory-only in AGT (never hard) and scored separately.

bathroom.png.notes: Windowless interior bathroom. Door leaf only partially visible at right frame edge (hence acceptable 0). Recessed light + vent fan + surface light on ceiling.

kitchen2.jpg.notes: One large black-framed multi-pane window unit over the sink (right wall) — arguably two sections, hence acceptable 2. One open black door (left); the doorway it reveals could be counted separately. Two rattan pendants. Open shelf is not a niche.

livingroom.jpg.notes: One curtained window (right, mostly blown out by exposure). Built-in bench niches flank the fireplace on both sides. Capiz chandelier; coffered ceiling.

bedroom2.png.notes: One large curtained picture window (multi-pane, one opening). Open white door at left (a second door/closet edge may be visible at the far left, hence acceptable 2). Flush-mount dome ceiling light.

bedroom.jpeg.notes: Empty room. One wide window wall unit: large central pane flanked by narrow grid side-lites — defensibly 1, 2, or 3 openings. No ceiling fixture visible. Barred exterior view of neighboring building.

kitchen.png.notes: All-white minimalist kitchen, no windows or doors in frame. Panel-front fridge and wall ovens are cabinetry/appliances, NOT doors — a known extractor trap. Recessed ceiling spots.
